item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a bedtime and a wind-down block built in, which is good. The gap is usually the hour before. Screens, planning, and unfinished thoughts follow you into bed. Tonight, treat the wind-down as non-negotiable. Dim the lights, put the phone out of reach, and let the day end on purpose. Action: set a phone alarm for your wind-down start and stop what you're doing when it rings.
